decision: D-018 (option A; was O-05): When the pin package is missing, the host hook file sends the host's block signal only before a tool runs. Session start, compaction, session end and prompt submit show the install message and carry on, matching the engine (dispatcher.ts). Known differences: the install itself is not let through (D-013); Grok unchanged (deny on every event); no session bookkeeping. If O-06 adds Claude's block-on-failure setting, it goes on the pre-tool hook only. Recorded as an interpretation, not an RC.

whyWinner: Matches what the working engine already does on every event.
